_about: Radiation reference values. Every number here has a source.

careerLimitSource.label: NASA Office of the Chief Health and Medical Officer: Radiation Protection technical brief (NASA-STD-3001)
careerLimitSource.quote: Career effective dose shall be less than 600 mSv.

displayBands.note: Colour bands on the career bar are chosen by this app. The only official number is the 600 mSv limit.

shelter: Go to the storm shelter: the crew quarters with extra water shielding. Rearrange water containers around your sleeping bag if the shelter is not ready. Stay until mission control or the dosimeter alarm clears.
